---
title: "Phase Portraits"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(moderndive)
library(fishualize)
```

```{r}

M1data <- read.csv("M1J0rank.csv")

# Create phase portrait
m1j0phase <- ggplot(M1data, aes(
  x = jpos0,
  y = jvel0
)) +

  # Trajectory through phase space
  geom_path(
    aes(colour = err_norm),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  # Individual data points
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = err_norm),
    size = 1.5
  ) +

  # Zero velocity reference line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +

  # Fishualize colour palette
  scale_colour_fish(
    option = "Ostracion_cubicus",
    name = "Prediction error"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Phase Portrait: M1 Joint 0",
    x = "Joint Position",
    y = "Joint Velocity"
  ) +

  theme_minimal()

ggsave("phaseportrait_M1J0_nrmse.png", plot = m1j0phase, width = 12, height = 8)
print(m1j0phase)
```
